To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TPA and, to a smaller extent, ISO and thapsigarin, increase NGF mRNA levels in C6- 2B cells.
the expression of NGF mRNA is increased by TPA, ISO, and thapsigargine, and that this effect is associated with increased binding to the AP- 1 responsive element in the NGF gene promoter.
TPA and ISO increase NGF mRNA levels in C6- 2B cells by different mechanisms, and that both mRNA transcription and stabilization contribute to the cAMP-mediated induction of NGF mRNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transcriptional regulation by TPA, ISO and thapsigargine of the rat NGFs gene in C6- 2B glioma cell line and its correlation with AP-1 binding to AP- 1NGF.
the identification of the molecular mechanisms regulating the transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation of the NGF mRNA.
the transcriptional mechanisms regulating the expression of nerve growth factor (ngf) mRNA in the CNS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TPA, a potent activator of protein kinase C, increases AP-1NGFB binding activity and NGF transcription.
AP-1 binding is correlated with the induction of NGF gene expression in C6- 2B rat glioblastoma cells.

TPA and ISO, but not thapsigargin (TG), stimulate AP-1 binding to the NGF promoter, and that TPA and TG induce NGF transcription and that TPA increases the stability of NGF mRNA whereas ISO increases both transcription and mRNA stability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

TPA and ISO induce the transcription of the NGF mRNA through a mechanism that is dependent on de novo protein synthesis, whereas thapsigargin increases the stability of NGF mRNA through an unknown mechanism.
AP-1 is a major transcription factor for NGF gene regulation.
TPA increases the NGF mRNA level by increasing the rate of NGF transcription whereas both transcriptional and mRNA stabilization mechanisms contribute to ISO-mediated NGF mRNA induction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
different signal transduction pathways regulate NGF gene expression in C6 glioma cells.
the transcriptional regulation by AP-1 of the rat NGFA promoter may contribute to the induction of NGF mRNA by a variety of extracellular signals in C6- 2B glioma.
the transcription factor AP-1 plays a role in the transcriptional regulation NGF expression.
